name: Honeydew
description: Connect your Honeydew cookbook to Claude. Search everything you've saved by ingredient, cuisine, or craving, browse your folders and tags, and pull up full ingredients, steps, notes, and nutrition for any recipe. Then put it to work: ask Claude to build a week of dinners from your favorites, or roll a few recipes into a single grocery list. Try "what can I make with chicken and spinach?", "plan three quick weeknight meals from my saved recipes," or "make a shopping list for these." Claude reads from your own collection — it never adds, edits, or deletes your recipes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Honeydew to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Honeydew to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.honeydewcook.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Honeydew MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Honeydew lists 26 MCP tools, including get_recipe_detail, list_folders, list_recent_recipes, list_tags, search_folders, search_recipes, create_recipe, set_recipe_favorite, append_recipe_note, add_recipe_tags, remove_recipe_tags, and create_folder.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Honeydew?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Honeydew in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Honeydew requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Honeydew is developed by Honeydew. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
